pillars.title: Fault-tolerant quantum computation by anyons
pillars.why: Defines TQC: braid for gates, fuse for readout, local-error immunity.

pillars.title: Non-Abelian Anyons and Topological Quantum Computation
pillars.why: Canonical review connecting anyons, FQHE, and computation.

pillars.title: Haah's code / X-cube fracton order
pillars.why: Error-confining memory pillar for DBE fracton store.

pillars.title: Discrete time crystals / Floquet phases
pillars.why: Clock subsystem for synchronized DBE control ticks.

papers.title: Fault-tolerant quantum computation by anyons
papers.plain: Move anyons around each other to compute; fuse them to read the answer.
papers.limitation: Abelian toric-code braids are not a universal gate set.

papers.title: Non-Abelian Anyons and Topological Quantum Computation
papers.dbe_link: Maps which anyon theories are universal.
papers.plain: Field guide to particles that remember how they were braided.
papers.why_matters: Standard language for anyon types and universality.
papers.limitation: Most candidate materials remain experimentally contested.

papers.title: Universal gates from braiding and fusing anyons on quantum hardware
papers.dbe_link: Fusion + braid completes a universal set on S3.
papers.plain: 54-qubit S3 order on Quantinuum H2; braid plus fusion yields a universal set and a magic state.
papers.why_matters: First hardware universal topological gate set of this type.
papers.limitation: Demo used linear-depth circuits, not the constant-depth adaptive protocol.

papers.title: Quantum computing with anyons is fault tolerant
papers.plain: Explicit error correction so anyon braiding stays reliable on noisy hardware.
papers.limitation: Assumes noise below threshold on a large device.

papers.title: Proof of a positive coherent-error threshold for topological quantum codes
papers.dbe_link: Coherent control errors are what coupled actuators inject.
papers.plain: Proves topological codes still have a threshold under small coherent Z rotations.
papers.why_matters: Coherent noise now has a theorem, not only numerics.

papers.title: A Modular, Topology-Aware Software Stack for Entanglement-Based Distributed Quantum Computing
papers.dbe_link: Software analog of modular braid routing.
papers.plain: Splits circuits across QPUs using the real network graph.

papers.title: Majorana braiding simulations with projective measurements
papers.plain: Simulate nanowire Majoranas braiding and being measured, including disorder.
papers.limitation: Trivial Andreev states can mimic MZM signatures.

papers.title: On prethermal time crystals from semi-holography
papers.dbe_link: Joins Floquet clock and holographic encoding.
papers.plain: A holographic plasma-like system rings as a drive-free time crystal.
papers.why_matters: Time-crystal clocks may emerge in holographic plasmas.
papers.limitation: Large-N theory, not a device spec.

papers.title: DBE-S Dynamic Barrier Evasion architecture
papers.dbe_link: Q=1000 target and WKB/decoherence/Bremsstrahlung failure modes.
papers.plain: Drive the Coulomb barrier coherently; account for decoherence and radiation.
papers.limitation: Program paper, not a measured Q.

papers.title: Dimensional Braid Engine modular processor
papers.plain: Braids compute, fractons remember, a time crystal clocks, holography compresses, actuators steer plasma.
papers.why_matters: Integration contract for scoring new papers.
papers.limitation: Vision document; code subsystems are stubs.
